moves.name: Standing Light Punch
moves.notes: As of March 2026 patch: can chain cancel.

moves.name: Standing Medium Punch
moves.notes: Has 16 frames of recovery on hit, but 18 on whiff. In February 27, 2024 patch: active frames increased from 3 to 5.

moves.name: Standing Medium Kick
moves.notes: Has 15 recovery frames on hit, but 17 on whiff.

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Stagger of +12 on Punish Counter, limited juggle state on anti-air Punish Counter.

moves.name: Crouching Light Punch
moves.notes: In February 27, 2024 patch: increased hitbox size forward.

moves.name: Crouching Medium Punch
moves.notes: 18 recovery frames on hit, 21 on whiff. June 2025 patch: startup from 8 to 7 frames.

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Punch
moves.notes: As of August 2026 patch: now poisons on Punish Counter.

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick
moves.notes: 20% initial scaling and 20% combo scaling.

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Limited juggle state on Punish Counter, Knockdown +48. June 2025 patch: increased hurtbox around feet.

moves.name: Down-Forward + Medium Punch (Pu Lao)
moves.notes: As of March 2026 patch: -3 on block.

moves.name: Forward + Heavy Punch (Chi Wen)
moves.notes: 20 recovery frames on hit, but 21 on whiff. August 2026 patch: on-block from -4 to -3 and active frames from 3 to 4.

moves.name: Forward + Heavy Kick (Qiu Niu)
moves.notes: 16 recovery frames on hit, but 24 on whiff. Low Crushes on frames 11-26.

moves.name: Light Punch, Light Punch (Hun Dun)
moves.notes: Second hit always scales to 270. Second hit has 14 recovery frames on hit, but 16 on whiff. As of March 2026 patch, second hit is +1 on hit (unchanged from -3 on block, despite patch notes saying it was).

moves.name: Heavy Punch, Heavy Punch (Qiong Qi)
moves.notes: Second hit Poisons on hit. 24 recovery frames on hit, but 29 on block. Knockdown of +54 if opponent is already poisoned. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. As of August 2026 patch: hit on non-poisoned opponent changed from blowback knockdown to a tailspin.

moves.name: Jump Medium Punch
moves.notes: Juggle state on air hit.

moves.name: Jump Light Kick
moves.notes: Crosses up.

moves.name: Forward Jump, Down + Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Can only hit Cross Up.

moves.name: Nightshade Pulse
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Cancellable into Forward+HP followup (Nightshade Chaser) on frames 30-36. Cancellable into OD Snake Step on frames 35-36.

moves.name: Nightshade Pulse (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Cancellable into Forward+HP followup (Nightshade Chaser) on frames 34-35. Cancellable into OD Snake Step on frames 32-33. Second hit puts opponent into a limited juggle state. Initial scaling of 20%.

moves.name: Nightshade Chaser
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. Possible to have up to a 5-frame delay for activation. As of August 2026 patch: now poisons on block (but not on Drive Parry).

moves.name: Nightshade Chaser, Burst
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates the Nightshade Pulse.

moves.name: Nightshade Chaser (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. Possible to have up to a 5-frame delay for activation.

moves.name: Nightshade Chaser (Overdrive), Burst
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates the Nightshade Pulse. Different advantage on hit/block if both Nightshade Pulse projectile hits connect first, versus one hit first, versus only detonation hitting.

moves.name: Orchid Spring
moves.notes: Places a pool on the ground for 160 frames. Poisons opponent (unblockable). Re-applies poison as long as opponent is in range. Can only have one Orchid Spring active at a time.

moves.name: Orchid Wreath
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Limited juggle state on hit. Not a projectile, so will not clash with other projectiles.

moves.name: Serpent Lash (Light Punch)
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. 20 recovery frames on hit, but 26 on whiff. Clashes with projectiles, but is a strike.

moves.name: Serpent Lash (Medium Punch)
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. Forces a Crumple when detonating Poison. Only the early active frames will hit grounded opponents.

moves.name: Serpent Lash (Heavy Punch)
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. Anti-air invincible on frames 6-16.

moves.name: Serpent Lash (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. Forces a Crumple when detonating Poison. Clashes with projectiles, but is a strike.

moves.name: Cruel Fate (Light Kick)
moves.notes: Knockdown on airborne opponents. As of August 2026 patch: on-hit from +1 to +2.

moves.name: Cruel Fate (Medium Kick)
moves.notes: Knockdown on airborne opponents.

moves.name: Cruel Fate (Heavy Kick)
moves.notes: Knockdown on airborne opponents.

moves.name: Cruel Fate (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Knockdown on airborne opponents. Can hold left/right to steer the move. Hit-grab animation on early hit. Non-hitgrab version can cancel into Level 3 Super as of May 2024.

moves.name: Snake Step (Light Kick)
moves.notes: A fake/feint dash. Upper body projectile invincible on frames 8-37. Moves backwards as of May 2024.

moves.name: Snake Step (Medium Kick)
moves.notes: A command dash. Upper body projectile invincible on frames 9-38. Will not cross up.

moves.name: Snake Step (Heavy Kick)
moves.notes: A command dash. Upper body projectile invincible on frames 11-40(50...54). Can cross up.

moves.name: Snake Step (Overdrive)
moves.notes: A command dash. Can cross up. Strike invincible on frames 1-34, Projectile invincible on frames 1-42. Strike and Projectile invincible for entire duration on cross up. Throws will punish counter for the entire duration of the move.

moves.name: Sinister Slide
moves.notes: Can be cancelled with "Up" input. Upper body projectile invincible on frames 10-197. Followups are usable from frame 11 onward, stance-cancel from frame 28 onward.

moves.name: Venomous Fang
moves.notes: Poisons on hit. Detonates Poison (Toxic Blossom) when hitting a poisoned opponent. Forces a Crumple when detonating Poison.

moves.name: Heel Strike
moves.notes: 17 recovery frames on hit, but 20 on whiff. Limited juggle state on aerial opponents.

moves.name: Entrapment
moves.notes: 17 recovery frames on hit, but 20 on whiff. Limited juggle state on aerial opponents.

moves.name: Deadly Implication (Level 1)
moves.notes: Strike/throw invincible on frames 1-12. Breaks armor. Poisons on hit.

moves.name: Tainted Talons (Level 2)
moves.notes: Breaks armor. Creates an ublockable poison pool for ~700 frames (does not prevent Orchid Spring pools). Light/Medium/Heavy Punch determines attack distance as well a the placement of the poison pool. MP and HP versions make the poison pool move forward slowly.

moves.name: Claws of Ya Zi (Level 3)
moves.notes: Fully invincible on frames 1-12. Breaks armor. Critical Art in parenthesis.
